description: Master posted to #content Slack channel via raw post.py command instead of invoking the master-slack skill at .claude/skills/master-slack/SKILL.md. The post succeeded and content was correct, but the skill wrapper was bypassed — meaning the eval signal file was not written and the skill invocation was not tracked. David corrected: 'you must use the .claude/skills/master-slack skill to post to the channel correctly'.
correction: All Slack posts must go through the master-slack skill, not raw post.py calls. The skill uses the same post.py mechanism but also handles eval signal file writing and enforces the no-duplicate rule.
proposed_fix: Before any Slack post, read .claude/skills/master-slack/SKILL.md. Use the skill as the invocation path. Write the eval signal file to systems/eval-harness/skill-runs/master-slack-latest.json on completion.
